sections.text: Substations
Technical Procedure
Introduction

This document outlines the major maintenance Procedure P1, to 
be performed 
after every 5000 operations or ten years as indicated by Y10 in the title block.
Preventive maintenance is a cycle of planned inspection, testes, overhauls and servicing activities designed to keep the network equipment in good operating condition and avoid breakdowns..

The first draft initiated by eng 
Emad Farouk Mostafa at 
Kattamia
substation 220kv and tested at 17 March 02
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution 
marks surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
CB isolated and earthed from two sides
Change remote position to maintenance

items: 1 Set of mechanic's tools
1 Commercial grade torgue wrench
1 Industrial vacuum - cleaner
Ladders or scaffolding
Over haul and with drawing denice

sections.text:
Work to be Carried Out
 Instruction for dismantling and 
 re-assembly the interrupter

Drain out SF6 gas from C.B 
 enclosure

Drain off the 
 hydraulic oil

All parts which come into contact with SF6 gas should be touched as little 
 as possible, insulators only with clean plastic gloves; when dismantled 
 cover them with polyethylene foil to keep them clean.

sections.text: Dismantling the interrupter

Disconnect the operating 
 mechanism 16700 from the three poles (fig 2/1)
Dismantle the housing

Disconnect the electric leads 
 from the connector plate on the operating mechanism 16700

Detach the hydraulic cylinder 
 from the external lever 13924 by removing screw 13934 and pin 13923 (fig 
 2/4)
Dismantle pin 16704

Disconnect the auxiliary switch 
 by unscrewing the castle ut 16686 and removing the vofaflex has

Dismantle the end position 
 inter lock 16740 from the crankcase

Release the fixing screws from 
 the mounting frame 16702

Release the fixing screws from 
 the base

Remove the complete operating 
 mechanism 16700 from the base 13965 (fig 2/1) to provide space for the with 
 drawing deuice

Assemble the over haul and with 
 drawing device 01221 (fig 4/3)

Mount support I 01222 and 
 support II 01223

Level the rails 01224 with a 
 spirit level

Mount the with drawing truck 
 10225 on the flange of the crank case

Dismantle the flanged cover 
 13895 with filter 13885, with renew the gas ret 13925

Undo all screws in the 
 crankcase

Carfully pull out the with 
 drawing truck with the interrupter 17602 and on reaching the end position, 
 hinge down wards with the crank case through 90

Lock the truck in the vertical 
 position with two securing pine 01226

Immediately it has been removed 
 from the enclosure, free the interrupter from switching dust as far as 
 possible, using the vacuisme cbaner

sections.text:
Adjust ment of the 
 interrupter

Move the interrupter to the 
 stop in the open position

Fit the end position inter lock 
 in suchainay that the pin of the externel leuer is flush

Push the pin of the inter lock 
 forward

Measure the clearance beween 
 the pin and the cam of the lever and make a note of it

Finally push the pin 
 of the end 
 position inter lock back again, move the interrupter into the closed 
 position and lock in this position by means of the end-position 
 inter lock.

sections.text: Insert the interrupter

Swing the truck of the 
 withdrawing 01221 with the interrupter att ached to it in the horizontal 
 position
Lubricate the contacts
Secure screwed joints loctite

Clean the inside of the 
 enelosure and the interrupter with the vacuum cleaner before inserting the 
 interrupter

Center the contact through the 
 opening in the filter flange

Screw up the crank - case 
 flange
